scope: Primary-source reference list checked through web retrieval. The supports field limits what a citation establishes; source inclusion does not fact-check an entire draft.

sources.title: EPA: Pest prevention and pesticide use
sources.supports: Address food, water, shelter and entry points; follow product labels.

sources.title: EPA: Termite identification and control
sources.supports: Identify termite evidence, correct moisture conditions and obtain a professional treatment assessment. This source does not establish EnviroCare prices or repair terms.

sources.title: EPA: IPM principles
sources.supports: IPM combines monitoring, thresholds, prevention and control decisions. Data-center workflow examples are editorial applications, not EPA certification.

sources.title: EPA: IPM in buildings
sources.supports: Building pest prevention requires coordinated responsibilities and documentation; this is general building guidance, not a data-center standard.

sources.title: CDC: Mosquito control at home
sources.supports: Empty, scrub, cover or remove water-holding containers weekly and maintain screens. This source does not establish EnviroCare treatment season or prices.

sources.title: CDC: Seal up to prevent rodents
sources.supports: Inspect gaps, seal entry points and manage food sources. Critical building penetrations require the facility team, not improvised residential repair methods.

sources.title: UC IPM: Ants
sources.supports: Combine species identification, sanitation, entry-point management and appropriate baiting; surface spraying alone does not prevent new entry.

sources.title: UC IPM: Cockroaches
sources.supports: Identification, sanitation, monitoring and targeted controls work together; distinguish indoor-breeding species from outdoor invaders.

sources.title: UC IPM: Silverfish and firebrats
sources.supports: Silverfish and firebrats feed on starchy stored items and paper-associated materials; management includes moisture and harborage conditions.

sources.title: UC IPM: Spiders
sources.supports: Reduce hiding places, remove webs and address the insects that support spider activity; identification matters.

sources.title: UC IPM: Fleas
sources.supports: Flea management involves the host and environment; cleaning and coordinated pet care are distinct from structural treatment.

sources.title: EPA: Total release fogger precautions
sources.supports: Fogger misuse can cause fire, explosion or exposure; label precautions and prevention remain essential.

sources.title: Alabama Extension: Managing fire ants with baits
sources.supports: Bait selection, permitted application site and foraging conditions affect results; follow the label and avoid unsupported home remedies.

sources.title: University of Minnesota Extension: Crickets
sources.supports: Common household cricket types include field, house and camel crickets; prevention and exclusion precede pesticide decisions.

sources.title: Alabama Extension: Termite inspection and seasonal conditions
sources.supports: Warm, humid conditions and rain affect swarming; inspection records document evidence and conducive conditions. Does not establish 2026 weather records, company call volumes or exact statewide swarm dates.

sources.title: Alabama Extension: Termite territory and control
sources.supports: Formosan infestations have been reported in central Alabama, beyond the coastal counties. Supports inspection and property-specific treatment selection, not a prediction for a particular town or property.

sources.title: Mississippi State Extension: Signs of termite infestation
sources.supports: Interpret swarm evidence by location and number; large indoor emergences and a few outdoor-origin Formosan swarmers have different implications. No company-specific field counts or damage timelines.

sources.title: Mississippi State Extension: Understanding termite swarms
sources.supports: Formosan swarmers are attracted to lights and can enter through openings; large indoor emergences warrant inspection. Mississippi annual activity reports must not be relabeled as Alabama or EnviroCare observations.

sources.title: Alabama Extension: Subterranean termite control products
sources.supports: Repellent/nonrepellent liquid treatments, bait colony effects and noviflumuron, construction-stage and postconstruction access, and bait alternatives for new construction. No universal dose, outcome deadline, superiority or company service commitment.

sources.title: Mississippi State Extension: Protect your house from termites
sources.supports: Bait feeding and ongoing station service, generally slower bait response versus liquid treatment, and possible targeted combinations for active infestations. No Alabama-specific timing, company price, guaranteed result or universal inspection interval.

sources.title: UC IPM: House mouse
sources.supports: Mice can enter through small openings or deliveries and can gnaw wiring. Supports inspection, exclusion and monitoring; does not substantiate outage rates, universal device choices or a facility service commitment.
